purpose: Prepare for a later need or leave a state unchanged.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
I will buy the tickets before the trip.
I read tomorrow’s documents in advance.
Observe a state, recognize preparation, or prepare in advance
restrictions: Often implies acting in advance; context can instead mean keeping something as it is.
mistake: It does not mean every action literally involves putting an object somewhere.
